datasources.sql: SELECT TO_CHAR(publish_date_ict, 'YYYY-MM') AS month_year, publisher, COUNT(article_id) AS alert_articles_recorded FROM news_articles WHERE is_duplicate = FALSE GROUP BY TO_CHAR(publish_date_ict, 'YYYY-MM'), publisher

SELECT sc.category_code, sc.category_name, COUNT(DISTINCT na.article_id) AS total_alert_articles, COUNT(DISTINCT aom.org_id) AS distinct_impersonated_orgs FROM scam_categories sc JOIN article_scam_mapping asm ON sc.category_id = asm.category_id JOIN news_articles na ON asm.article_id = na.article_id LEFT JOIN article_org_mapping aom ON na.article_id = aom.article_id WHERE na.is_duplicate = FALSE GROUP BY sc.category_code, sc.category_name

SELECT u.url_id, u.domain, u.ground_truth_label, lf.url_length, lf.domain_length, lf.subdomain_count, lf.special_char_ratio, lf.entropy_score, lf.has_ip_address, lf.is_shortened FROM url_dataset u JOIN lexical_features lf ON u.url_id = lf.url_id
